body_md:
These seven plumbers list Sarasota in their service area and hold a Florida Certified Plumbing Contractor license checked as current and active, expiring 08/31/2028. Public records and company sites describe them as family-owned, owner-operated, or veteran-owned, or show no parent company. Service areas, hours, and stated work differ, so match the listing to your address and job, then confirm details with the company.

## How we picked

Each license was checked on a Florida DBPR licensee detail page or DBPR license-number search result. The check recorded license type, number, status, and expiration. Addresses, phones, websites, hours, service areas, ownership notes, and stated services come only from those records and the company sites. Facts on this page tie back to those sources. Contacts were checked on 2026-10-28.

## At a glance

- All seven licenses are Certified Plumbing Contractor and listed current and active, expiring 08/31/2028. Numbers are CFC057045, CFC057842, CFC1426615, CFC1428540, CFC1430135, CFC1431820, and CFC1434139.
- Every service area names Sarasota or Sarasota County, with different neighbors: Palmetto and Venice; Manatee County; Siesta Key, Lido Key, and Longboat Key; Nokomis and Southwest Florida; Pinellas and parts of Hillsborough and Polk.
- Stated history runs from Wimpy’s Plumbing & Air (serving Sarasota families since 1973) and Professional Plumbing & Design, Inc. (family owned and operated since 1985) to Hershman Plumbing, Inc. (established in 2004), Loftin Plumbing, LLC (established in 2018), and Redemption Plumbing Services, LLC (founded in 2022). Years are not stated for Pro-Plumbing Works, LLC or Plumbing Detectives LLC.
- Listed hours: Professional Plumbing & Design, Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–4:30 PM, 24-hour emergency service Friday–Sunday, phones staffed 24/7; Pro-Plumbing Works, Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–4:00 PM, after-hours emergency available; Redemption, office Monday–Friday 8 AM–5 PM and Saturday 8 AM–12 PM, emergency service 24/7. Hours are not listed for the other four.

## Things to know before you go

Match the named cities to your address before you call. Professional Plumbing & Design (4450 Middle Ave, Sarasota) lists Sarasota and surrounding Bradenton, Palmetto, and Venice. Wimpy’s Plumbing & Air (7867 Fruitville Road, Sarasota) and Pro-Plumbing Works (2341 Porter Lake Drive, Ste 208, Sarasota) list Sarasota and Manatee counties. Hershman Plumbing (1818 Mango Ave, Sarasota) lists Sarasota, Siesta Key, Lido Key, Lakewood Ranch, Venice, Bradenton, and Longboat Key. Loftin Plumbing is listed in Bradenton and serves Sarasota, Bradenton, Lakewood Ranch, and Manatee County. Plumbing Detectives LLC is at 312 E Venice Ave #203, Venice, and lists Venice, Sarasota, Nokomis, and Southwest Florida. Redemption Plumbing Services is at 2908 Florida Blvd, Bradenton, and lists Manatee, Sarasota, and Pinellas counties, plus parts of Hillsborough and Polk.

Stated work also differs. Professional Plumbing & Design and Hershman list residential and commercial plumbing. Professional also lists water filtration, re-piping, jet cleaning, video inspection, and pipe lining, and states it is not a franchise, with upfront pricing and a 100% satisfaction guarantee stated on its site. Plumbing Detectives describes owner-operated, diagnosis-first residential plumbing, including leak detection, sewer camera inspection, water heater work, and repiping. Loftin lists family-owned residential service, luxury new construction plumbing, bathroom remodels, gas piping, drain and sewer work, and water heaters. Wimpy’s lists plumbing and HVAC and also lists license CAC1820127 on its site. Redemption lists veteran-owned residential and commercial work, upfront pricing, bonded and insured, drain cleaning, water heaters, sewer camera inspection, and emergency plumbing. Pro-Plumbing Works lists family-owned flat-rate pricing, free estimates, and a 5-year conditional labor warranty; the DBPR record for CFC1428540 lists primary name BURNS, CHARLES VINCENT and DBA THE DRAIN PROS.

Named owners in the records are Matt Wittman and Ben Wittman; Bubba Butler and Mike Butler; Ashley J. Hershman; Charles “Chuck” Burns; Trevor Loftin and Shelbi Loftin; Mike Reynolds; and Brett Remmelsberger. Hershman’s Florida Division of Corporations filing P04000148254 lists Ashley J. Hershman as president and Christina E. Hershman as vice president, with no parent company shown. A phone is listed for six companies. None was in the checked record for Loftin Plumbing, LLC; its website is https://www.loftinplumbing.com/.

## FAQ

### Are these licenses current?

As of the 2026-10-28 check, each is a Certified Plumbing Contractor license shown current and active on a Florida DBPR page, expiring 08/31/2028. Sources are a DBPR licensee detail page or DBPR license-number search results.

### Which listings include emergency or weekend hours?

Professional Plumbing & Design lists 24-hour emergency service Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, with phones staffed 24/7. Pro-Plumbing Works lists after-hours emergency service. Redemption lists Saturday office hours and 24/7 emergency service. Hours are not listed for Wimpy’s Plumbing & Air, Hershman Plumbing, Loftin Plumbing, or Plumbing Detectives.

### Do they cover the same parts of the Sarasota area?

No. Each names Sarasota or Sarasota County, but nearby coverage differs—Palmetto, Venice, Manatee, the keys, Lakewood Ranch, Nokomis, Pinellas, and parts of Hillsborough and Polk appear on different listings. Compare those names with your address, then confirm with the company.
